There is only ONE Riven.

Riven is holding her original large sword.

The sword is COMPLETELY INTACT throughout this entire scene.

The sword must NOT break.

Riven is completely REACTIVE in this scene.

Riven does NOT attack the Mystery Figure.

Riven does NOT charge forward.

Riven does NOT initiate combat.

She only sees the threat,
becomes confused,
raises her sword defensively,
and is suddenly overwhelmed.


MYSTERY FIGURE:

Use the provided MYSTERY FIGURE reference image
as the visual identity of the mysterious attacker.

There is only ONE Mystery Figure.

Keep its overall mysterious dark form consistent with the reference.

However, throughout this scene,
the Mystery Figure must remain difficult to see clearly.

It is partially hidden by:

dense smoke,
darkness,
orange firelight,
and fast motion blur.

Do NOT clearly reveal its face.

Do NOT clearly reveal its exact body structure.

Do NOT clearly reveal how it attacks.

Do NOT clearly reveal a weapon.

Do NOT show the Mystery Figure punching Riven.

Do NOT show a normal hand attack.

Do NOT show a conventional sword attack.

The Mystery Figure never speaks.


=== CHARACTER COUNT ===

There are exactly TWO active figures:

1. Riven
2. Mystery Figure

There is exactly ONE Riven.

There is exactly ONE Mystery Figure.

No Father.

No soldiers.

No Ally Soldier.

No villagers.

No additional humans.

No additional creatures.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided BURNING VILLAGE reference
as the environment reference.

Use the provided final frame from the previous sequence
as the starting visual continuity.

The entire scene takes place inside the SAME burning village.

Thick smoke fills the village street.

Burning wooden buildings create strong orange firelight
through the dark smoke.

Ash and embers drift through the air.

Visibility is limited.

No location change.

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Grounded realistic human anatomy.

Realistic physical impact.

Natural hair, cloth, smoke, ash and fire physics.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Keep the scene visually SIMPLE and READABLE.

Keep the Mystery Figure visually UNCLEAR.

Avoid excessive cuts.

Avoid complicated choreography.

No extended combat.

No dialogue.

No voice-over.

No narration.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.

No background music.

Riven stands inside the burning village.

She looks confused and unsettled.

Through the dense smoke and fire ahead,
she can barely see the vague dark shape
of the Mystery Figure.

Riven does not understand what she is seeing.

She cautiously raises her intact sword
into a defensive position.

Riven remains completely defensive.

Then—

without warning—

the vague dark figure suddenly accelerates
through the smoke at extreme speed.

Its movement is so fast
that its exact attack cannot be clearly understood.

The Mystery Figure becomes a rapid dark motion
surging through the smoke.

Riven cannot react in time.

A sudden violent impact hits Riven.

Riven is completely overwhelmed.

She is violently thrown backward.

Her intact sword flies out of her hands.

Riven crashes onto the ground FACE-DOWN.

Her intact sword lands separately
several feet away from her.

CUT.

Riven stands inside the burning village.

Firelight flickers across her face.

Dense smoke moves through the environment behind her.


Riven looks forward.


Her expression is confused,

uneasy,

and increasingly alarmed.


She does not move toward the threat.


CUT TO:


Riven's view into the burning village.


Through thick smoke and orange firelight,

the MYSTERY FIGURE is barely visible in the distance.


Keep the Mystery Figure vague and difficult to read.


Only a dark ambiguous silhouette
can be perceived through the smoke.


The figure appears partially lost
inside the smoke and firelight.


Do NOT show the Mystery Figure clearly.


The audience should not understand
exactly what they are looking at.


CUT BACK TO:


Riven.


Riven continues staring at the vague figure.


She looks confused and uncertain.


She does not know what the figure is.


Riven slowly brings her INTACT sword up with both hands.


She takes a defensive stance.


Riven remains completely passive and defensive.


She does NOT move toward the Mystery Figure.


She does NOT attack.


She does NOT charge forward.


She simply prepares herself defensively.


Hold only a brief moment.


Then—


SUDDENLY:


The Mystery Figure explosively accelerates
through the dense smoke toward Riven.


Do NOT show normal running.


Do NOT clearly show individual footsteps.


Do NOT show a conventional attack animation.


Instead,


the vague dark silhouette becomes
a rapid dark motion surging through the smoke.


Its movement is extremely fast,

brief,

and difficult to visually read.


Smoke violently shifts around the movement.


The dark form crosses the distance toward Riven
almost instantly.


Riven cannot visually follow the movement.


Riven is completely caught off guard.


She is already holding her sword defensively,

but the attack is far too fast.


She cannot properly block it.


Before Riven can react—


IMPACT.


A sudden violent force strikes Riven.


Do NOT clearly reveal what physically struck her.


Do NOT clearly show a hand striking Riven.


Do NOT clearly show a weapon striking Riven.


Do NOT explain the attack.


Do NOT turn this moment into a sword clash.


Do NOT create a duel.


The audience should only understand that:

the Mystery Figure suddenly moved at extreme speed,

and Riven was instantly overwhelmed.


The impact violently throws Riven backward.


Riven loses her grip on her sword.


Her INTACT sword flies completely out of her hands.


Riven is thrown through the air.


She crashes hard onto the dirt.


IMPORTANT:


RIVEN LANDS FACE-DOWN.


RIVEN LANDS IN A PRONE POSITION.


Her chest and stomach are toward the ground.


Her back is facing upward.


Riven does NOT land on her back.


Riven does NOT lie face-up.


After hitting the ground,

Riven remains lying FACE-DOWN.


Her head is turned slightly to one side
so part of her face can still be visible.


She is conscious,

but completely stunned.


Her intact sword lands separately.


The sword hits the dirt
and slides several feet away from Riven.


IMPORTANT:


THE SWORD REMAINS COMPLETELY INTACT.


The sword does NOT break.


The sword is now beyond Riven's immediate reach.


Riven remains FACE-DOWN on the ground.


Do NOT make Riven roll onto her back.


Do NOT make Riven sit up.


Do NOT make Riven stand.


Do NOT continue the attack.


The Mystery Figure remains unclear
inside the smoke.


CUT.

Riven is alive.

Riven is conscious but stunned.


Riven is lying FACE-DOWN on the ground.

Riven is in a PRONE position.

Her chest and stomach face the dirt.

Her back faces upward.

Her head is turned slightly to one side.


Riven is NOT lying on her back.

Riven is NOT face-up.

Riven does NOT sit up.

Riven does NOT stand.


Riven is NOT holding her sword.


Riven's sword remains COMPLETELY INTACT.

The sword has NOT broken.

The intact sword is lying on the dirt
several feet away from Riven.

The sword is beyond Riven's immediate reach.


The Mystery Figure has NOT been clearly revealed.

Its attack method remains unknown.

No clear weapon has been shown.

No clear physical attack has been shown.


Riven has NOT attacked the Mystery Figure.

Riven has NOT successfully blocked the attack.

There has NOT been an extended fight.


The final state must clearly establish:

RIVEN LYING FACE-DOWN ON THE GROUND.

RIVEN'S BACK FACING UPWARD.

THE INTACT SWORD LYING SEVERAL FEET AWAY.

THE MYSTERY FIGURE STILL UNCLEAR THROUGH THE SMOKE.


This leads directly into the opening sequence,

where Riven must struggle across the dirt
to reach her intact sword.


CUT.

Mysterious.

Unsettling.

Sudden.

Overwhelming.

Violent but restrained.

Riven should feel completely outmatched.

Do not explain the Mystery Figure's movement.

Do not explain its attack.

Do not turn the scene into a fight.


The key visual progression is:


CONFUSED RIVEN.


CUT.


VAGUE MYSTERY FIGURE
BARELY VISIBLE THROUGH SMOKE AND FIRE.


CUT.


RIVEN RAISES HER INTACT SWORD DEFENSIVELY.


THE DARK FIGURE SUDDENLY BECOMES
A RAPID DARK MOTION THROUGH THE SMOKE.


RIVEN CANNOT REACT.


IMPACT.


RIVEN IS VIOLENTLY THROWN BACKWARD.


HER INTACT SWORD FLIES FROM HER HAND.


RIVEN CRASHES FACE-DOWN ONTO THE GROUND.


THE INTACT SWORD LANDS SEVERAL FEET AWAY.


RIVEN REMAINS FACE-DOWN.


CUT.
